privacy.p_scope: This policy describes how the public marketing website at meshchatx.com (the "Site") handles information when you visit pages on the Site. It does not govern the MeshChatX application, Reticulum, or third-party services you may use separately.
privacy.p_no_tracking: We do not collect analytics telemetry, we do not run advertising, and we do not track you across the web. The Site does not load third-party analytics, advertising, or social tracking pixels.
privacy.p_cookies: Any cookies or browser storage used by the Site are strictly functional. They exist only so the Site can remember preferences you choose or that your browser already signals.
privacy.p_cookies_detail: Examples include theme preference (light, dark, or follow system), and language preference when you select a locale or when we match your browser Accept-Language header on first visit. These are not used for advertising, profiling, or cross-site tracking.
privacy.p_analytics: Download, version, and interface-directory data are loaded from this Site. When the cache expires, the Site fetches public GitHub release metadata for MeshChatX and the submitted online list from directory.rns.recipes. That process is not advertising and is not used to build a personal profile.
privacy.p_analytics_detail: If you follow download, source, donation, or documentation links, those requests go to the host you click through to. Those third parties have their own policies.
privacy.p_rights: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of personal data, and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. This marketing Site is designed to keep processing minimal. If you have a specific request regarding this Site, contact us as below and we will respond as required by applicable law.
privacy.p_contact: For privacy questions about this Site, see the contact page.

hero.lead: MeshChatX is an all-in-one Reticulum client with messaging, calling, and a NomadNet browser.

section.infra_lead: Traffic goes over Reticulum mesh links, not a MeshChatX-operated backend.

feature.decentralized_p: Built on Reticulum. No MeshChatX-operated message servers. Identities and message history stay on your device.
feature.crypto_p: Reticulum publishes its crypto design in an open specification. MeshChatX uses that stack unchanged.
feature.mesh_p: MeshChatX runs over internet links, radio, LoRa, and other transports that Reticulum supports.
feature.platform_p: Desktop (Electron) and web (Docker or Python). Android ships as an APK and via Termux.
feature.sandbox_p: Windows desktop builds run in :appcontainer. Linux builds use :landlock and :seccomp where the kernel supports them.

security.lead: Desktop releases ship with provenance attestations, package integrity checks, and native OS sandboxing where the platform allows it.
security.bullet_slsa: SLSA Level 3 provenance for release builds.
security.bullet_asar: ASAR integrity monitoring detects tampering with packaged application resources.
security.bullet_sandbox: Native OS sandboxing: AppContainer on Windows, Landlock and seccomp-bpf on Linux.
security.bullet_sigstore: Sigstore cosign-based signing for verifiable artifacts where applicable.
security.bullet_sast: Static analysis and dependency scanning with Trivy, pip-audit, Ruff, and CodeQL in the delivery pipeline.
security.bullet_csp: CSP plus tight defaults for remote content in the Electron shell (including CORS discipline where it applies).
security.bullet_transport: HTTPS and WSS by default for remote pages and transports where supported.

split.item1_p: Create as many identities as you need. Switch between them without mixing their data stores.
split.item2_p: No government ID, phone number, or email. Join without third-party identity checks.
split.item3_p: Messages propagate across the mesh. Local archives keep history available when a remote peer is offline.

roadmap.lead: Major MeshChatX releases land about every two to three months. Each entry lists the work planned for that version.
roadmap.notice: Dates and features can move as priorities change.

branding.logo_lead: Full mark at common export sizes. PNG and WebP keep transparency. JPG variants sit on white or near-black.

branding.wordmark_lead: Navbar-style mark sized by height in pixels.

git.lead: rngit is Git over Reticulum and the canonical tree. GitHub and LavaForge are public mirrors for CI and releases.
git.rngit_lead: Git over Reticulum. Clone on the mesh or open the NomadNet repo page. No clearnet endpoint.
git.github_lead: Public mirror used for releases, CI, and distribution. Fine for most contributors.
git.lavaforge_lead: Community forge mirror. Useful if you already live on LavaForge.
